node.statement: Star and unit calculation. Source corner adjoints obey (pi_j X pi_k)^dagger=pi_k X^dagger pi_j. The packaged merging0 involution clause in def-four-corner-merging-datum says gamma_kj,n(Z^dagger)=gamma_jk,n(Z)^dagger, so summing the four blocks yields gamma_n(X^dagger)=gamma_n(X)^dagger exactly. The source unit has only diagonal blocks pi_1,pi_2. The two diagonal-unit clauses give ||gamma_jj,n(pi_j)-I_n tensor P_j||<=rho, and amplified target complementarity gives ||I_n tensor(P_1+P_2)-I||<=rho. The triangle inequality therefore gives ||gamma_n(I)-I||<=3rho. Together with node #0 this proves node 1.1.
